khams yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na rlung gi khams yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na nam mkha'i khams yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na rnam par shes pa'i khams yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na ma rig pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na 'du byed yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na mying dang gzugs yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na skye mched drug yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na reg pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na tshor ba yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na sred pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na len pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na srid pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na skye ba yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na rga shi yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs

su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na nang stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na phyi stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na chen po stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na 'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha

rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na yang dag par spong ba yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na dbang po yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na stobs yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na byang chub

kyi yan lag yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na 'phags pa'i bden pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na bsam gtan yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na tshad myed pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na rnam par thar pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na mngon par shes pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na ting nge 'dzin yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na gzungs kyi sgo yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na myi 'jigs pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na so so yang dag par rig pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na snying rje chen po yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na dgra bcom pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na rang byang chub yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni gzugs yongs su dag pa'o/ /tshor ba la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni tshor ba yongs su dag pa'o/ /'du shes la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni 'du shes yongs su dag pa'o/ /'du byed la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang /

rnam par byang ba myed pa ni 'du byed yongs su dag pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor myig la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni myig yongs su dag pa'o/ /rna ba la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rna ba yongs su dag pa'o/ /sna la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni sna yongs su dag pa'o/ /lce la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni lce yongs su dag pa'o/ /lus la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni lus yongs su dag pa'o/ /yid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni yid yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor gzugs la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni gzugs yongs su dag pa'o/ /sgra la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni sgra yongs su dag pa'o/ /dri la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni dri yongs su dag pa'o/ /ro la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni ro yongs su dag pa'o/ /reg la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa

ni reg yongs su dag pa'o/ /chos la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni chos yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor myig gi rnam par shes pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni myig gi rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni sna'i rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni lce'i rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni lus kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor myig gi 'dus te reg pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs ba myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon

mongs ba myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yongs su dag pa'o/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su dag pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su dag pa'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su dag pa'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su dag pa'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su dag pa'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la skye ba

myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byord sa'i khams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni sa'i khams yongs su dag pa'o/ /chu'i khams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon rmongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni chu'i khams yongs su dag pa'o/ /mye'i khams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni mye'i khams yongs su dag pa'o/ /rlung gi khams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rlung gi khams yongs su dag pa'o/ /nam mkha'i khams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni nam mkha'i khams yongs su dag pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rnam par shes pa'i khams yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor ma rig pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon rmongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni ma rig pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /'du byed la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni 'du byed yongs su dag pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /mying dang gzugs la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa

myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni mying dang gzugs yongs su dag pa'o/ /skye mched drug la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni skye mched drug yongs su dag pa'o/ /reg pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni reg pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /tshor ba la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni tshor ba yongs su dag pa'o/ /sred pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni sred pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /len pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni len pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /srid pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni srid pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /skye ba la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni skye ba yongs su dag pa'o/ /rga shi la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rga shi yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la skye ba myed pa dang /

'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor nang stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni nang stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /phyi stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni phyi stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /chen po stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni chen po stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs

su dag pa'o/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa

stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni yang dag par spong ba yongs su dag pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon rmongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /dbang po rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni dbang po yongs su dag pa'o/ /stobs rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni stobs yongs su dag pa'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni byang chub kyi yan lag yongs su dag pa'o/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni 'phags pa'i

lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni 'phags pa'i bden pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /bsam gtan rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni bsam gtan yongs su dag pa'o/ /tshad myed pa rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni tshad myed pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rnam par thar pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni mngon par shes pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed

pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni ting nge 'dzin yongs su dag pa'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni gzungs kyi sgo yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs yongs su dag pa'o/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni myi 'jigs pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni so so yang dag par rig pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /snying rje chen po la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni snying rje chen po yongs su dag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad yongs su dag pa'o/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yongs su dag pa'o/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yongs su dag pa'o/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa

dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yongs su dag pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa ni dgra bcom pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /rang byang chub la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa ni rang byang chub yongs su dag pa'o/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang nam mkha' yongs su dag pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na nam mkha' yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byord nam mkha' la 'go ba myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na nam mkha' la 'go ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byord nam mkha' gzung du myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor nam mkha' la tha snyad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs

su dag pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na nam mkha' la tha snyad ma mchis pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' sgra brnyan gnyis kyi sgra ltar nam mkha' la tha snyad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor nam mkha' brjod du myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na nam mkha' brjod du ma mchis pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor nam mkha' la ni gang yang brjod du myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du nam mkha' brjod du myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang nam mkha' dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na nam mkha' dmyigs su ma mchis pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor nam mkha' la gang yang dmyigs su myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du nam mkha' dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos thams cad skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na chos thams cad skye ba ma mchis pa dang / 'gag pa ma mchis pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa dang / rnam

par byang ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor chos thams cad shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das de la myig gi nad 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro/ /rna ba'i nad dang / sna'i nad dang / lce'i nad dang / yan lag ma tshang bar myi 'gyur ro/ /lus ngan par myi 'gyur ro/ /rga pas 'khogs pa'i lus su myi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de ni myi bde ba myi spongs pas dus byed par myi 'gyur ro/ /de'i slad bzhin lha brgya stong mang po 'brang bar 'gyur te/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha dang sum cu rtsa gsum dang / mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang / tshangs pa kun 'khor dang tshangs chen dang snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad myed snang ba dang / kun snang dang ba dang / dge ba dang / chung dge dang / tshad myed dge dang / dge rgyas dang / che ba dang chung che dang / tshad myed che ba dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / myi che ba dang myi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang gya nom snang ba dang / 'og myin gyi lha rnams kyang slad bzhin du 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /gang na chos smra ba'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa 'di ston pa der yang chos brgyad dang bcu bzhi dang bco lnga dag la lha'i tshogs chen po 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ston pa'i tshe bsod nams mang du 'phel bar 'gyur te/

rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de ni bsod nams kyi phung po rab tu mang ba tshad ma mchis pa grangs ma mchis pa bsam gyis myi khyab pa mtshungs pa ma mchis pa gzhal du ma mchis pa dpag tu ma mchis pa rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang chos brgyad dang bcu bzhi dang bco lnga dag la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di lha'i 'khor gyi mdun du ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de ni bsod nams mang du 'phel te/ bsod nams kyi phung po mang ba/ tshad myed pa grangs myed pa bsam gyis myi khyab pa mtshungs pa med pa/ gzhal du med pa dpag tu myed pa rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rin po che'o/ /rab 'byor de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rin po che ni 'di lta ste/ sems can dmyal ba las yongs su grol bar byed pa'o/ /byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang myi dang lha dbul po las yongs su grol bar byed pa'o/ /rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba'i rigs 'byin pa'o/ /bram ze che zhing mtho ba'i rigs 'byin pa'o/ /khyim bdag che zhing mtho ba'i rigs 'byin pa'o/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /mtshe ma'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /dga' ldan gyi lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /'phrul dga'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /tshangs ris kyi lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha'i skye

ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /tshangs chen gyi lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /snang ba'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /chung snang gi lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /tshad myed snang ba'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /dge ba'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /chung dge'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /tshad myed dge ba'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /dge rgyas kyi lha'i skye pa'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /che ba'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /chung che'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /tshad myed che ba'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /myi che ba'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /myi gdung ba'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /gya nom snang ba'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /'og myin gyi lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /chung zad myed pa'i lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'byin pa'o/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'byin pa'o/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'byin pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa nyid 'byin pa'o/ /rang byang chub 'byin pa'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'byin pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rgyas par bstan te/ de la bslabs pas rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /

khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams yod do/ /mtshe ma'i lha rnams yod do/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams yod do/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams yod do/ /snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung snang gi lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung dge'i lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams yod do/ /che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung che'i lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'og myin gyi lha rnams yod do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /chung zad med pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid yod do/ /rang byang chub yod do/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di yod na/ bsam gtan bzhi yod do/ /tshad myed pa bzhi yod do/ /gzugs med pa'i

snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi yod do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi yod do/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi yod do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi yod do/ /dbang po lnga yod do/ /stobs lnga yod do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun yod do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yod do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyind pa yod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa yod do/ /nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /chen po stong pa nyid yod do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid yod do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yod do/ /bsam gtan bzhi yod do/ /tshad myed pa bzhi yod do/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi yod do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yod do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yod do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum yod do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams yod do/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad yod do/ /gzungs kyi sgo thams cad yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yod do/ /mi 'jigs pa bzhi yod do/ /so so yang dag

par rig pa bzhi yod do/ /byams pa chen po yod do/ /snying rje chen po yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad yod do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid yod do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid yod do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yod do/ /de yang 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las chos de thams cad rgya cher bstan te/ de la bslabs na rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams yod do/ /mtshe ma'i lha rnams yod do/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams yod do/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams yod do/ /snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung snang gi lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung dge'i lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams yod do/ /che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung che'i lha rnams yod do/ /tshad med che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'og myin gyi lha rnams yod do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye

mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams yod do/ /phyir myi 'ong pa rnams yod do/ /dgra bcom pa rnams yod do/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams yod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yod do/ /de bas na de la pha rol tu phyin pa rin po che zhes bya'o/ /pha rol tu phyin pa rin po che de la ni chos gang yang skye ba 'am 'gag pa 'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa 'am/ rnam par byang ba 'am/ yongs su gzung ba 'am dor ba myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gang skye ba 'am 'gag pa 'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa 'am/ rnam par byang ba 'am yongs su gzung ba 'am dor bar bya ba'i chos de lta bu myed do/ /rab 'byor pha rol tu phyin pa rin po che 'di la ni dge ba 'am myi dge ba 'am 'jig rten pa'am/ 'jig rten las 'das pa 'am/ zag pa dang bcas pa 'am zag pa myed pa 'am/ 'dus byas sam 'dus ma byas kyi chos gang yang dmyigs su myed do/ /rab 'byor rnam grangs des kyang pha rol tu phyin pa rin po che ni dmyigs su myed do/ /rab 'byor pha rol tu phyin pa rin po che la ni chos gang gis kyang 'go ba myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gang 'go bar 'gyur ba'i chos de lta bu dmyigs su myed do/ rab 'byor de'i phyir na pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'go ba myed pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /rab 'byor gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ de ltar 'du shes pa yang myi byed la de ltar myi rtog cing de ltar myi dmyigs te/ de ltar 'phro bar yang myi byed na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sgom pa'o/ /de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mnyes par byed pa'o/ /

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mngon par bsams shing sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la rim gror bya ba dang / bkur stir bya ba dang / phu dud du bya ba dang mchod par bya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro ste/ sems can yongs su smyin par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyang ba byed cing sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro'o/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni chos gang yang ston pa 'am rnam par ston pa 'am yongs su ston pa 'am/ 'dzin par byed pa 'am 'byin par byed pa 'am skye bar byed pa 'am 'gog par byed pa 'am/ kun nas nyon mongs par byed pa 'am/ rnam par dag par byed pa 'am/ 'grib par byed pa 'am 'phel bar byed pa 'am/ 'das pa 'am/ ma 'ongs pa 'am/ da ltar byung bar byed pa myed do/ /rab 'byor de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'dod pa'i khams las 'da' bar byed pa ma yin/ gnas par byed pa ma yin/ gzugs kyi khams las 'da' bar byed pa ma yin/ gnas par byed pa ma yin/ gzugs myed pa'i khams las 'da' bar byed pa ma yin/ gnas par byed pa ma yin// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu gsum pa/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ nang stong pa nyid sgrub

pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ phyi stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ phyi nang stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ chen po stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ yang dag par spong ba rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ dbang po rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ stobs rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ bsam gtan rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ tshad myed pa rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa

rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ rnam par thar pa rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ mngon par shes pa rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ ting nge 'dzin rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams sgrub pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ myi 'jigs pa rnams sgrub pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams sgrub pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ byams pa chen po sgrub pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ snying rje chen po sgrub pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sgrub pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu sgrub pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu sgrub pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu sgrub pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ dgra bcom pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ rang byang chub sgrub pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sgrub pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'dus byas kyi khams 'dor ba ma yin/ 'dus ma byas kyi khams sgrub pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ma byung yang rung / chos rnams kyi chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa de ni de bzhin du gnas pa yin te/ de ni de

bzhin gshegs pas mngon par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par thugs su chud do/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ mngon par rdzogs par thugs su chud nas kyang gsung ngo / ston to rjod do/ 'grel to/ rnam par 'byed do/ gsal bar mdzad do/ yang dag par ston to/ /de nas lha'i bu stong phrag mang po steng gi bar snang la 'khod nas lhung lhung ldags kyi sgra phyung ste/ lha rdzas kyi me tog ud+pa la dang / pad+mo dang / ku mud dang / puṇ+da ri ka dang / man+dā ra ba dang / man+dā ra ba chen pos 'thor zhing 'di skad kyi tshig brjod par gyur to/ /kye ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bstan pas/ lha'i bu stong phrag du ma skye ba myed pa'i chos la bzod pa skyes par gyur te/ 'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa bskor bar mthong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas brtan rab 'byor la bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis su bskor ba yang ma yin gcig tu bskor ba yang ma yin no/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yang chos gang yang 'khor ba 'am/ myi 'khor bar bya ba'i phyir nye bar gnas pa ma yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di chos gang yang 'khor bar bgyi ba 'am/ myi 'khor bar bgyi pa'i slad du nye bar myi gnas pa'i dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ngo / /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ngo / /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ngo / /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong ngo / /tshul

khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ngo / /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong ngo / /nang stong pa nyid nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /phyi stong pa nyid phyi stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /phyi nang stong pa nyid phyi nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /chen po stong pa nyid chen po stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /don dam pa stong pa nyid don dam pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /'dus byas stong pa nyid 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /chos thams cad stong pa nyid chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /yang dag par spong ba rnams yang dag par spong ba rnams kyis stong ngo / /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /dbang po rnams dbang po rnams kyis stong ngo / /stobs rnams stobs rnams kyis stong ngo / /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyis stong ngo / /'phags pa'i lam yan

lag brgyad pa 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pas stong ngo / /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /bsam gtan rnams bsam gtan rnams kyis stong ngo / /tshad myed pa rnams tshad myed pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /rnam par thar pa rnams rnam par thar pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pas stong ngo / /mngon par shes pa rnams mngon par shes pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /ting nge 'dzin rnams ting nge 'dzin rnams kyis stong ngo / /gzungs kyi sgo rnams gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis stong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyis stong ngo / /myi 'jigs pa rnams myi 'jigs pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /byams pa chen po byams pa chen pos stong ngo / snying rje chen po snying rje chen pos stong ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bus stong ngo / /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong ngo / /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong ngo / /dgra bcom pa nyid dgra bcom pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /rang byang chub rang byang chub kyis stong ngo / /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa

nyid kyis stong ngo / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni chen mo ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rang bzhin stong pa'o/ /de ni chos thams cad chos thams cad kyis stong la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya yang chos gang yang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba ma mchis chos kyi 'khor lo yang skor la chos gang yang 'khor ba 'am myi 'khor ba 'am rab tu 'khor bar bgyid pa ma mchis te/ de dag gi chos gang yang yongs su mthong ba 'am/ yongs su ma mthong ba ma mchis pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gang 'khor bar bgyi ba 'am myi 'khor bar bgyi ba 'am/ rab tu 'khor bar bgyi ba'i chos de lta bu dmyigs su ma mchis te/ de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad kyang shin tu mngon par ma grub pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ stong pa nyid ni 'khor bar bgyid pa 'am myi 'khor bar bgyid pa ma lags so/ /mtshan ma ma mchis pa ni 'khor bar bgyid pa 'am myi 'khor bar bgyid pa ma lags so/ /smon pa ma mchis pa ni 'khor bar bgyid pa 'am myi 'khor bar bgyid pa ma lags so/ /de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa dang rab tu bstan pa dang bsgrags pa dang rab tu dgod pa dang / gzhag pa dang / rnam par dbye ba dang / rnam par dgrol ba dang smos pa dang gsal bar bgyi ba dang / yang dag par bstan pa 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa de yang sus kyang ma bstan sus kyang ma bzung ngo / /gang sus kyang ma bstan

sus kyang ma bzung ba de ni sus kyang mngon du ma bgyis so/ /gang sus kyang mngon du ma bgyis pa de la ni yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa ma mchis te/ chos bstan pa 'di la gang su yang sbyin pa'i gnas su 'gyur ba ma mchis so/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las le'u nyi shu brgyad do// //de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nam mkha' myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mnyam pa nyid kyi pha rold tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rnam par dben pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni thug pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni gnas ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mying dang lus myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nam mkha'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/

bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni brjod du ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mying ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mchi ba ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad 'gro ba myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni myi 'phrogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad gzung du myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni skad cig pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad byang zhing zad pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni skye ba ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad skye ba dang / 'gag pa myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni byed pa po ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byed pa po dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa

'di ni shes pa po ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shes pa po dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'pho ba ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'chi ba dang skye ba myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'jig pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad 'jig pa myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rmyi lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rmyi lam mthong ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni sgra brnyan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyan pa dang sgrar brjod pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni myig yor gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mye long gi bzhin dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni smyig rgyu'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chu 'bab pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni sgyu ma'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtshan ma dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni

rmongs pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ma rig pa'i mun pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di ni rnam par byang ba ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyon mongs pa'i sems can myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dmyigs su ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni spros pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyind pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ spros pa thams cad yang dag par bcom pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rlom sems ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rlom sems thams cad yang dag par bcom pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni myi g.yo ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos kyi dbyings gnas pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'dod chags dang bral ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal

pa/ chos thams cad ma nor ba yang dag pa nyid du mngon par 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni kun nas ldang ba ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad rnam par rtog pa myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni zhi ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad mtshan ma myed cing dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'dod chags ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dod chags dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni zhe sdang ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zhe sdang yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni gti mug ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ myi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad sel ba'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yongs su rtog pa myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni sems can ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sems can myed pa'i phyir ro/ /

gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rab tu spangs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad kun nas ldang ba myed pa'i phyir ro/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mtha' gnyis su myi 'gyur ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtha' rnam par spong ba'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni tha myi dad pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad 'dres pa myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nyams pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyis las 'da' bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rnam par rtog pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni tshad ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad kyi tshad dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nam mkha'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad la chags pa myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni myi rtag pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad 'jig pa myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni sdug bsngal gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad tshol bar sbyor ba myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bdag ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad la mngon par chags pa myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mtshan nyid ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad mngon par grub pa myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nang stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nang gi chos dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni phyi stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phyi'i chos dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phyi nang gi chos dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni stong pa

nyid stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni chen po stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chen po stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ don dam pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phyi nang gi chos dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dben pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dben pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dngos po myed pa'i chos nyid kyi phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos rnams ngo bo nyid kyis dben pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dngos po myed pa'i

ngo bo nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lus dang tshor ba dang sems dang chos dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni yang dag par spong ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge ba dang myi dge ba'i chos dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dbang po'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dbang po lnga dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stobs lnga dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni byang chub kyi yan lag gi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab

kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa dang / rnam par dben pa'i rnam pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mtshan ma ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zhi ba'i rnam pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni smon pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ smon pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnam par thar pa brgyad dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bden pa bzhi'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sbyin pa dang ser sna dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshul khrims dang tshul khrims ngan pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyind pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnod sems dang bzod pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ le lo dang brtson 'grus dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bsam gtan dang 'khrug pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shes rab dang 'chal ba'i shes rab dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ thabs ma yin pa dmyigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ smon lam ma yin pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stobs chung ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/

bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ myi shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni stobs bcu'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad thub pa myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi ye shes zhum pa myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni so so yang dag par rig pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid chags pa myed pa dang / thogs pa myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni snying rje chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sems can thams cad yongs su myi gtong ba'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ brjod pa thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid kyi phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rang byung gi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u nyi shu dgu'o// //de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo gang gi rna lam du grag pa de dag ni sngon gyi rgyal ba la bsnyen bkur byas pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di sems can gang gi/ rna lam du grag pa de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di sems can gang gi rna lam du grag pa de dag ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba'o/ /gang 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang klog cing kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing bzung ba dang / 'chang ba dang / klag pa dang kun chub par byas nas kyang de bzhin nyid du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la nan tan du byed pa lta ci smos te/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos nas/ myi 'jigs/ myi sngang / skrag par myi 'gyur ba de dag gis sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos nas myi 'jigs myi sngang skrag par myi 'gyur ba de dag gis sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom

pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la yongs su dris so yongs su zhus so/ /rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos nas myi 'jigs myi sngang skrag par myi 'gyur zhing thos nas kyang 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag ni bskal pa bye ba mang por sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad do snyam pa dang / de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos nas kyang myi 'jigs myi sngang skrag par myi 'gyur zhing thos nas kyang 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de dag ni phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang 'dra bar gzung bar bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni zab pa ste/ sngon sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ma spyad pas ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos kyang mos par bgyi bar myi nus so/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos nas spang bar sems pa de dag gis ni sngon gyi mthar yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu

phyin pa zab mo 'di spangs par gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bshad pa'i tshe/ dad pa dang mos pa ma mchis pa'i slad du ste/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis sngon gyi mthar yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang nyan thos rnams la bsnyen bkur ma bgyis te/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la ni ji ltar spyad par bgyi/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ni ji ltar spyad par bgyi/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la ni ji ltar spyad par bgyi/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ni ji ltar spyad par bgyi/ bsam gtan gyi pha rold tu phyin pa la ni ji ltar spyad par bgyi/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ni ji ltar spyad par bgyi/ nang stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ phyi stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ phyi nang stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ chen po stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ don dam pa stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni ji
