gal te bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te nang stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te phyi stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te phyi nang stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te stong pa nyid stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chen po stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te don dam pa stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'dus byas stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rang bzhin stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chos thams cad stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold

tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa la spyod do/ /gal te yang dag par spong ba rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dbang po rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te stobs rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te byang chub kyi yan lag rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te bsam gtan rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshad myed pa rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /

gal te rnam par thar pa brgyad zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mngon par shes pa rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ting nge 'dzin rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzungs kyi sgo rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myi 'jigs pa bzhi zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te snying rje chen po zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te thams cad shes pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnams thams cad mkhyen pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzugs kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs ma yin no/ /

tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ tshor ba ma yin no/ /'du shes kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ 'du shes ma yin no/ /'du byed kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ 'du byed ma yin no/ /rnam par shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /myig gi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ myig ma yin no/ /rna ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba ma yin no/ /sna'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sna ma yin no/ /lce'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lce ma yin no/ /lus kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lus ma yin no/ /yid kyi thab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ yid ma yin no/ /gzugs kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs ma yin no/ /sgra'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sgra ma yin no/ /dri'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ dri ma yin no/ /ro'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ ro ma yin no/ /reg gi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ reg ma yin no/ /chos kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ chos ma yin no/ /myig gi rnam phaRa shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lce'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i zab pa nyid

gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /sa'i khams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sa'i khams ma yin no/ /chu'i khams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ chu'i khams ma yin no/ /mye'i khams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ mye'i khams ma yin no/ /rlung gi khams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rlung gi khams ma yin no/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ nam mkha'i khams ma yin no/ /rnam par shes

pa'i khams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par shes pa'i khams ma yin no/ /ma rig pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ ma rig pa ma yin no/ /'du byed kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ 'du byed ma yin no/ /rnam par shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /mying dang gzugs kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ mying dang gzugs ma yin no/ /skye mched drug gi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ skye mched drug ma yin no/ /reg pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ reg pa ma yin no/ /tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ tshor ba ma yin no/ /sred pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sred pa ma yin no/ /len pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ len pa ma yin no/ /srid pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ srid pa ma yin no/ /skye ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ skye ba ma yin no/ /rga shi'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rga shi ma yin no/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /nang stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ nang stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /

phyi stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ phyi stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ phyi nang stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ chen po stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ don dam pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dran pa

nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ma yin no/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ yang dag par spong ba rnams ma yin no/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ma yin no/ /dbang po rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ dbang po rnams ma yin no/ /stobs rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ stobs rnams ma yin no/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ma yin no/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ma yin no/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ma yin no/ /bsam gtan rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ bsam gtan rnams ma yin no/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ tshad myed pa rnams ma yin no/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ma yin no/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par thar pa brgyad ma yin no/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ma yin no/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ma yin no/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ mngon par shes pa rnams ma yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi zab pa

nyid gang yin pa de ni/ ting nge 'dzin rnams ma yin no/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams ma yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ma yin no/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi ma yin no/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ma yin no/ /snying rje chen po'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ snying rje chen po ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad ma yin no/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ thams cad shes pa nyid ma yin no/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ma yin no/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gal te gzugs gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'du shes gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'du byed gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gting dpag dka'

zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzugs gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sgra gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dri gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ro gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te reg gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chos gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna'i rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce'i rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus kyi rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes

bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid kyi rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna'i 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce'i 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus kyi 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid kyi 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sa'i khams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chu'i khams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mye'i khams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rlung gi khams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te nam mkha'i khams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par shes pa'i khams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ma rig pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'du byed gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mying dang gzugs gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te skye mched drug gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te reg pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sred pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te len pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /

gal te srid pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te skye ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rga shi gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa la spyod do/ /gal te brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te nang stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te phyi stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te phyi nang stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chen po stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te don dam pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka'

zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'dus byas stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rang bzhin stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chos thams cad stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yang dag par spong ba rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dbang po rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te stobs rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te byang chub kyi yan lag rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te bsam gtan rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshad myed pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par thar pa brgyad gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mngon par shes pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol

tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ting nge 'dzin rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzungs kyi sgo rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myi 'jigs pa bzhi gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te snying rje chen po gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa la spyod do/ /gal te thams cad shes pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzugs kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs ma yin no/ /tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ tshor ba ma yin no/ /'du shes kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ 'du shes ma yin no/ /'du byed kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ 'du byed ma yin no/ /rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /myig gi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ myig ma yin no/ /rna ba'i gting

dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba ma yin no/ /sna'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sna ma yin no/ /lce'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ lce ma yin no/ /lus kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ lus ma yin no/ /yid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ yid ma yin no/ /gzugs kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs ma yin no/ /sgra'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sgra ma yin no/ /dri'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ dri ma yin no/ /ro'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ ro ma yin no/ /reg gi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ reg ma yin no/ /chos kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ chos ma yin no/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ lce'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /lce'i 'dus

te reg pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /sa'i khams kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sa'i khams ma yin no/ /chu'i khams kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ chu'i khams ma yin no/ /mye'i khams kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ mye'i khams ma yin no/ /rlung gi khams gyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rlung gi khams ma yin no/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ nam mkha'i khams ma yin no/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams

kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par shes pa'i khams ma yin no/ /ma rig pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ ma rig pa ma yin no/ /'du byed kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ 'du byed ma yin no/ /rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /mying dang gzugs kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ mying dang gzugs ma yin no/ /skye mched drug gi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ skye mched drug ma yin no/ /reg pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ reg pa ma yin no/ /tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ tshor ba ma yin no/ /sred pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sred pa ma yin no/ /len pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ len pa ma yin no/ /srid pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ srid pa ma yin no/ /skye ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ skye ba ma yin no/ /rga shi'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rga shi ma yin no/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang

yin pa de ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /nang stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ nang stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ phyi stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ phyi nang stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ chen po stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ don dam pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /myi dmyigs

pa stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ma yin no/ /yang dag par spong pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ yang dag par spong ba ma yin no/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ma yin no/ /dbang po'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ dbang po ma yin no/ /stobs kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ stobs ma yin no/ /byang chub kyi yan lag gi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ byang chub kyi yan lag ma yin no/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ma yin no/ /'phags pa'i bden pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa ma yin no/ /bsam gtan gyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ bsam gtan ma yin no/ tshad myed pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ tshad myed pa ma yin no/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ma yin no/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi

gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par thar pa brgyad ma yin no/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ma yin no/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ma yin no/ /mngon par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ mngon par shes pa ma yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ ting nge 'dzin ma yin no/ /gzungs kyi sgo'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ gzungs kyi sgo ma yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ma yin no/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi ma yin no/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa ma yin no/ /snying rje chen po'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ snying rje chen po ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ma yin no/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ thams cad shes pa nyid ma yin no/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ma yin no/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gal te gzugs tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'du shes tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'du byed tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzugs tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sgra tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dri tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ro tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te reg tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te

chos tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor

ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sa'i khams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chu'i khams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mye'i khams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rlung gi khams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te nam mkha'i khams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par shes pa'i khams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ma rig pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'du byed tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mying dang gzugs tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol

tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te skye mched drug tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te reg pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sred pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te len pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te srid pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te skye ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rga shi tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te nang stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te phyi stong

pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te phyi nang stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te stong pa nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chen po stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te don dam pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'dus byas stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi+i spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rang bzhin stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chos thams cad stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid

tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yang dag par spong ba rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dbang po rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te stobs rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te byang chub kyi yan lag rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te bsam gtan rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshad myed pa rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par thar pa brgyad tshad
